features.description: Add Request.ReasoningEffort string to internal/ai/provider.go (documented: '', off, low, medium, high). Add the 5 typed sentinel errors (ErrInvalidReasoningEffort, ErrUnsupportedReasoningEffort, ErrConflictingReasoningConfig, ErrInvalidThinkingBudget, ErrReasoningBudgetExceedsMaxTokens) as package-level errors wrapped via NewAIError(CodeSchemaValidation, msg, false) (REUSE per M0). Build the ONE shared resolver (ResolveReasoning) implementing: independent validation of all 4 inputs; deterministic precedence (typed effort vs reasoning_effort; thinking_budget_tokens Gemini/Anthropic-only with strict Go int type + provider ranges; reasoning_max_tokens deprecated OpenRouter-only step 4); conflict rules (identical=ok, differ=conflict, both numeric-budget names=always conflict, effort+reasoning_max_tokens on OpenRouter=conflict). Build the fresh provider/model capability table (empty of live-unverified models; UNKNOWN=reject). Resolver returns a normalized decision struct (per-provider mapped budget/effort/off) consumed by M2-M5. NO provider wiring yet.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Request.ReasoningEffort string documented with exactly 5 valid values.
AC4: invalid effort strings + non-string Options[reasoning_effort] -> ErrInvalidReasoningEffort.
AC5: invalid thinking_budget_tokens Go types (float/json.Number/string/uint) + out-of-range -> ErrInvalidThinkingBudget; unsupported provider presence -> reject (not ignore).
AC6: precedence deterministic — identical typed/legacy accepted; differing -> ErrConflictingReasoningConfig; numeric budget must equal simultaneously-supplied effort mapping else conflict.

AC7 (resolver half): reasoning_max_tokens is int>=1, OpenRouter-only; non-OpenRouter presence -> ErrUnsupportedReasoningEffort; +effort on OpenRouter -> ErrConflictingReasoningConfig; +thinking_budget_tokens ALWAYS conflict (checked before per-provider rules).
Capability table: UNKNOWN model + non-empty control -> ErrUnsupportedReasoningEffort. No live-unverified entries added.
All 5 sentinels wrap to a non-retryable AIError (errors.As -> AIError, Code=SchemaValidation, Retryable=false).

Table-driven unit tests for the resolver in isolation (no provider clients): all 5 effort values, invalid values, invalid option types/ranges, every 4-input precedence combination, MaxTokens==0 / budget==MaxTokens / budget==MaxTokens-1 boundary logic, B==0/off with MaxTokens unset accepted.
